HUSHFIELD / ONE EVOLVING PIECESmall gestures. Evolving sound.

HUSHFIELD / ONE EVOLVING PIECE

Small gestures.
Evolving sound.

Hushfield is a playable space for making ambient music. Move the four voice dots to bend a chord and place it in the stereo field. Let melodies unfold, reshape a sample into grains, or set Orbit in motion for changing rhythms.

Layer chords, melody, air and samples, then shape their shared sound with magnetic tape echo. Scope, spectrum and vector views reveal the music through a dithered black-and-white display.

Foundation sets the harmony. Texture reshapes its recent audio or your own recordings. Motion adds Orbit notes that follow the same harmony. Space and Tape shape the whole piece. Your audio and session stay in this browser. Save a project file to keep its sample and settings. Microphone access is requested only when you choose Record.
